text:
deploy-bot: Alert: rollout 2.7.1 -> us-west-2 slice (15%) exceeded p95 latency SLO (480ms > 350ms). Auto-rollback scheduled in 3m unless manually acknowledged. :rotating_light:

noah.sre: noticed error churn on transformer-gpu-1; secondary nodes showing high decode time.

nora-sre: pinging @sofia.eng and @jen-releases 15% canary includes some VIP customers in that slice; avoid broad rollback if possible.

sofia.eng: can we immediately scope traffic to exclude VIPs and shrink overall percent? I'd prefer targeted traffic control first.

jen-releases: we can do a split: `releasesctl traffic update --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 3 --exclude-segment vip-customers` then pause autorevert.

deploy-bot: To suppress auto-rollback: `deploy-bot ack --by nora-sre --duration 30m`. Note: suppression will be logged.

carol-ops: ops runbook: `releasesctl traffic update` is the right call. I'll run it now.

noah.sre: executing: `releasesctl traffic update --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 3 --exclude-segment vip-customers` -> done.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback timer paused (ack by nora-sre). Hold expires at 1755571797.

sofia.eng: checking logs 10m window: root traces point at a new runtime kernel switch `attn_fuse_v2=true` that landed in the build. Suspect kernel-level regressions on long-seq decoding.

noah.sre: can we toggle that flag at runtime for the slice without redeploy? If yes, let's flip and stress test.

jen-releases: ops pattern: `releasesctl flag set --release 2.7.1 --name attn_fuse_v2 --value false --scope us-west-2` then run a synthetic load. If stable, roll traffic up.

carol-ops: prepping notify: short message to #customer-ops: "We reduced rollout in us-west-2 due to transient latency; investigating. No customer action required."

sofia.eng: quick note: embeddings-heavy jobs are isolated to dedicated-pool-eu; not in this slice, so safe to proceed with flag flip.

noah.sre: flipping flag on staging subset: `releasesctl flag set --release 2.7.1 --name attn_fuse_v2 --value false --scope staging-fuse-2` -> started. Running 1.5k synthetic requests.

deploy-bot: Annotated: `acknowledged_by: nora-sre`, `hold_expires_at: 1755571797`.

jen-releases: fallback plan if flip fails: full rollback to 2.7.0 with staged cutover and customer comms. Rollback command below.

jen-releases: fallback script:
```
releasesctl rollback --from 2.7.1 --to 2.7.0 --regions us-west-2 --mode immediate --notify customer-ops
```

carol-ops: creating incident ticket for audit and postmortem: INC-1822. Also drafting a one-liner for release notes: "Canary traffic reduced in us-west-2 for latency investigation."

noah.sre: synthetic run p95=305ms (baseline 285ms). No 502s. Extending hold by @noah.sre for 45m to validate further.

sofia.eng: good. if we stay stable, let's ramp 3 -> 10% over 15m and monitor. Also file REL-5211 to gate attn_fuse_v2 behind a preflight QA check for future rollouts.

jen-releases: ramp command executed: `releasesctl traffic update --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 10` (ramp window 15m).

carol-ops: monitoring dashboards 10m: p95 trending ~320ms, a bit higher than baseline but within acceptable range. No customer-facing rollback required. Sending status to #customer-ops now.

noah.sre: note for follow-up: add a regression test that runs long-sequence artifacts against attn_fuse_v2 on PRs. Also consider defaulting the flag off for canaries until stable sign-off.

deploy-bot: Final: auto-rollback suppressed, no rollback executed. Handoff to REL-5211 and INC-1822 for follow-up. Thread archived.
